images.author: Niceckhart
images.caption: A former Rax Restaurant in Vermilion, Ohio.

brief: A c. 1980 fast-food restaurant: a single-storey brick box with a sloped glass solarium dining room along the side under a dark roof band, a car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a former Rax roast-beef restaurant (Vermilion OH, c.1980), now a sports pub: the chain's signature curved glass solarium on the front, a shed roof with a coloured fascia, a brick wainscot; a pad site at a corner with landscaping and its own parking

why.note: the 1980s fast-food greenhouse solarium: a chain's identity in the building
a dead chain's pad building reused (the duck's shape lingers)
